title: What Is a Motif? — A Literary Guide for English Students and Teachers
skills: define motif and distinguish it from theme and symbol
identify recurring images, ideas, objects, or patterns in a text
analyze how motifs contribute to theme and meaning
support literary interpretations with textual evidence
alignment_note: Explains motif as a recurring literary element that develops ideas, reinforces themes, and contributes to a text's larger meaning. Supports close reading, symbolism analysis, thematic interpretation, and evidence-based literary analysis across high school English courses.
